lines: [sly] [fast] Ten bucks a bet. Coin flips. You pick first.
[fast] You pick heads, heads, tails. I pick tails, heads, heads.
[confident] First one to show up wins. And I win three games out of four.
[deadpan] Here's the trick. Your heads-heads only wins if it lands first.
[fast] Any later, a tails came right before it. That's my combo. I finish first.
[happy] A hundred games. You win twenty-five. I win seventy-five.
[smug] You're down five hundred dollars. On a perfectly fair coin.
[whisper] So... ten bucks a bet. You pick first.
